mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the previous quarter indicates strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances following a GDP increase, or GDP growth fails to predict positive returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decrease and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over the previous month indicates increased economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances following an INDPRO increase, or INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the previous month, it signals a strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint movement in PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to predict positive returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% over the previous month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint increase in CPIAUCSL and high FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances following a RSAFS decrease, or RSAFS decrease fails to predict negative returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).
